info.title: AlWasp
info.description:
AL symbol restore and config-driven multi-project build tool for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
      Declarative alwasp.json config with apps/tests inventory, profiles, and targets.
      Deterministic symbol restore from NuGet feeds with incremental manifest caching.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: ALWasp — AL symbol package restore and multi-project build tool for Business Central. Run 'alwasp init' to get started, or 'alwasp --help' for available commands.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Create an alwasp.json config file in the current directory. Scans direct child folders for app.json and populates the 'apps' list. Run 'alwasp config validate' after editing to confirm the config is correct.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite alwasp.json if it already exists in the current directory [default: False]

options.name: --include-tests-by-name
options.description: Convenience heuristic: automatically move discovered folders whose name ends with 'Test' or 'Tests' into the 'tests' section. This is not reliable for all naming conventions — always review the result. [default: False]

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate alwasp.json and print all errors. Exits 0 when the config is valid, 1 when errors are found. Use --config to validate a file at a non-default path.

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to alwasp.json project configuration file (auto-detected if omitted)

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Calculate each selected project's effective version from its 'versioning' settings in alwasp.json and PERMANENTLY write it to app.json. Requires alwasp.json (config-driven project selection only). Unlike 'build', this does not restore symbols, compile, or touch git — it only updates app.json.

commands.description: Manage cached AL compiler tools (alc / altool)

commands.name: update
commands.description: Check NuGet.org for a newer version of the AL tools (alc / altool) and download it when one is available. Use --clean to remove older cached versions, or --check for a dry run.

options.name: --clean
options.description: After ensuring the latest version is present, remove all other cached tool versions from ~/.alwasp/tools. [default: False]

options.name: --check
options.description: Only report whether a newer version is available; do not download or remove anything. Exits 0 when up to date, 2 when an update is available. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable verbose logging [default: False]

options.description: Minimal output [default: False]

commands.name: set-package-id
commands.description: Assign a new random deployment package ID to a .app file so it can be re-uploaded to a Business Central sandbox. Does not change the app identity (app.json id).

options.description: Write the modified .app to this path instead of overwriting the original.
